prompt: 請分析 data.csv 中的重要趨勢，並製作適合的資料視覺化。
planned_difference: Only with_agents contains the assignment AGENTS.md
limitations: One run per condition cannot establish a general causal effect.
Agents can follow general model defaults even without project AGENTS.md.
session_design: Two fresh agents with fork_turns=none, run sequentially; both receive the same task and operational boundaries, with only their working-directory paths differing.
common_operational_boundaries: Read only the assigned project directory, not other experiments or conversation history.
Do not use subagents or operate GitHub.
Execute the analysis and retain code and outputs; report commands and validation.
Home directory is read-only; caches may use /tmp.

rule_assignment.without_agents: No AGENTS.md in its original assigned directory or experiment parent.
rule_assignment.with_agents: Exact copy of the existing assignment AGENTS.md.

publication_note: Archived directories inside GitHub are evidence snapshots, not the original experimental roots. Root project instructions can apply if users rerun them directly inside the repository.
prompt_reduction_measurement: Both runs receive the same short prompt; no separate trial varying prompt length was performed.
